code:
services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:16
    environment:
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}

  inventory-mock:
    image: mockserver/mockserver:latest
    ports: ["1080:1080"]

  product-catalog:
    build: ./services/product-catalog
    ports: ["8081:8080"]
    depends_on: [postgres]

  checkout:
    build: ./services/checkout
    environment:
      INVENTORY_URL: http://inventory-mock:1080
    ports: ["8082:8080"]
    depends_on: [postgres, inventory-mock]
caption: Four services, one command: postgres, inventory-mock, product-catalog, checkout
